hook.name: CLOCKFeeHook
hook.description: A volatility-adaptive swap-fee hook for ETH/token pools launched via the CLOCK launchpad. Charges fees in native ETH on buys (via beforeSwap delta) and sells (via afterSwap delta), scaling between a configurable base and max rate (0.3%–5%) based on the tick movement of the previous swap. Only supports exact-input swaps; exact-output swaps revert.
